parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: RFC 8707 resource indicator. The parameter may repeat; every value must be an absolute URI without fragment that a resource server registered through token_introspection.resources and whose allowlist names the requesting client. Otherwise the request fails with invalid_target.

schema.description: RFC 8707 resource indicators (absolute URIs without fragment). At the token endpoint they may only narrow the access token to a subset of the granted resources; client_credentials rejects them with invalid_target.
schema.title: ResourceIndicators
